base.role: CUDA 13.0.3, PyTorch and vendor runtime libraries only. SGLang (with its Rust extensions), FlashInfer with its cubin bundle and DeepGEMM are rebuilt from the sources below.

patches.head: 871033059f872000a0f53be9a469845ca88f1e57
patches.reason: CPU-tested (123 tests) and Codex-reviewed (READY); prices verify context per request in allocation order, with per-step and per-verify-token parts fitted from 32K and 128K shared-prefix cells on real text with the deployment's top_p. The upstream PR is posted with the GPU measurements from this candidate.
patches.purpose: --speculative-dspark-sps-autotune off|auto|force: fit the DSpark SPS cost table at startup from real decode steps per (batch size, verify tier) plus a per-verify-token context term, cached per configuration (no manual profiling step).

patches.purpose: Opt-in ragged-verify token tiers below one request's width (SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_SUB_WIDTH_TIERS).

patches.head: 776e249d86b62fe63a9f982b554a511d078f90ab
patches.reason: Restored: 0.2.0 carried it; rc4 dropped it unmeasured. Production sampling uses top_p 0.95, where compact-verify padding rows are uniform, FlashInfer radix top-p's worst case. Carried at its upstream branch head on main.
patches.purpose: Skip top-p renormalization on compact-verify padding rows.

patches.head: c13326d97a930743da7f9c1d5816afc3538e4978
patches.reason: Restored correctness fix: 0.2.0 carried it; rc4 dropped it unmeasured. Compact verify pre-added the verify lengths, so DSv4.1 candidate graph selection counted the verify window twice. Carried at its upstream branch head on main.
patches.purpose: Compact verify hands self-adding backends committed CPU lengths, as static verify does.

patches.head: 19e6e4d5c6dda75c9db688f5a605c81e6d3277c7
patches.reason: Restored: 0.2.0 carried it and rc4 dropped it unmeasured; without it decode at 390K context is 11% (C1) to 24% (C8) slower than 0.2.0. Its upstream PR is posted with the GPU measurements. Carried at its upstream branch head on main.
patches.purpose: Paged decode consumer layers score only their candidate blocks.

patches.head: 7000f04ea823f1f56d19a07591d2ed3a9e1fdce1
patches.purpose: SM120 decode/verify WO-A reads an exact FP8 copy of its BF16 weight (SGLANG_DSV41_WO_A_FP8_COPY, default on).
patches.note: #43008 is the same single commit re-parented onto bare main, where its kernel registrations collide with #42867's at the same place in gemm/__init__.py; the tested rebased copy (diff_base its old A/B-chain parent) applies cleanly after #42867 and makes the identical change.

patches.head: 0b14f90927398831bb015a8dfc1cbb60291d9bab
patches.reason: Reviewed (Codex, no majors) and CPU-tested; the upstream PR is posted after the GPU image checks on this candidate.
patches.purpose: Encoder SWA bounded replay accepts image requests: the replay window carries the request's own multimodal inputs, so image prompts keep HiCache host-tier hits.

patches.head: 37c1886567f77cfc7e838b7edb4db3d5f1dfa07f
patches.reason: Reviewed (Codex, no majors) and CPU-tested; fixes serving OOM crashes in long-context prefill. Upstream route (support #40967 or post with credit) decided after the GPU check on this candidate.
patches.purpose: DSv4.1 prefill indexer score tiles sized from free memory with their scratch counted and no padded copy, so tile memory no longer grows with context length (OOM crash fix).

patches.head: 4070feebb9033b56e31e9f7497662116e79a3c72
patches.reason: Reviewed (Codex) and CPU-tested. Recorded C1 sessions on rc18 show the host planner sizes each step from confidences two steps old; a per-request running average models +1.2% (short context) and +2.7% (143K) at C1, no change at C2/C4. Enabled in the deployment with SGLANG_DSPARK_BUDGET_SURVIVAL_EMA.
patches.purpose: DSpark host budget planner sizes each step from a per-request running average of the lagged survival (opt-in); request-pool generations stay unique across a pool clear.

patches.head: a038a0dca05cefca1e0edc4ac43e3bfbec2e064c
patches.purpose: Backport of the merged V4.1 encoder fix matching DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 encoding/encoding.py: tool results that only carry tool output do not start a new turn (current-turn reasoning is kept), list-form tool and user content, and images collected after tool results are sorted.
patches.resolution: Upstream test_serving_chat.py imports drifted after the pin; the patch is regenerated against the 0.2.1 effective tree. The encoder source diff is patch-id identical to upstream.

packaging.rationale: SGLang main pins the published FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1; FlashInfer main is 0.7.1 with no published wheel, so its pin is rewritten and the cubin bundle is built from the same commit (its downloader verifies the source-pinned checksum manifest). DeepGEMM dev leaves VERSION at 0.0.0; it gets SGLang's required version plus a local commit suffix. typeguard 4 repairs the vendor base's typeguard conflict, Pillow stays at the vendor's patched >=12.3, NCCL keeps the vendor's deliberate 2.30.7 floor, and MoviePy is an unused diffusion extra whose Pillow<12 bound would downgrade the decoder.

allowed_conflicts: The package `cosmos-guardrail` requires `imageio>=2.37.0`, but `2.36.0` is installed
The package `cosmos-guardrail` requires `opencv-python>=4.10.0.84`, but it's not installed
The package `retinaface-py` requires `opencv-python`, but it's not installed
The package `nixl` requires `nixl-cu12==1.5.0`, but it's not installed
dependency_gate.rationale: The vendor base deliberately substitutes headless OpenCV, CUDA 13 NIXL and NCCL 2.30.7, and SGLang's diffusion extra pins imageio 2.36.0. Every other `uv pip check` result fails the build.
